description: Jan Evertsenstraat 9-33 odd and 24-38 even (J.M. van der Mey fronts, 1924-26): red brick spandrels, three triple-light casement windows per 6 m house, continuous projecting white sill and head bands on every upper storey with yellow-brown brick piers between the windows (two-tone), a low plain parapet with a thin coping, shops under one continuous white rigid canopy with a sign band of wall over it; no glass block

parapet.note: the row's crown: 1.21 m of plain red brick over the top storey (12.79-14.0 m on 19-23), a thin grey coping

corner-group-parapet.note: 35-41 (Admiralengracht end): a 2.8 m parapet over the storeys (12.5-15.3 m on 37-39) carrying the diamond-brick frieze (not drawn)

corner-tower.note: 35 (147692): the raised corner mass over the whole narrow front, a flat top 1.3 m over the corner-group parapet; the half-round oriel stack under it is not drawn

rhythm.identicalBays: every upper storey the same: three windows between a white sill band and a white head band
rhythm.groundFloor: shop under the row's continuous white canopy; a sign band of wall over the canopy
rhythm.signage: per house, on the wall band over the canopy
rhythm.roofline: low plain parapet with a thin coping, one line along the row
schemaLimits: the white bands' small dentil blocks under the head band are not drawn
the canopy sits on the measured wall band; its photo height is read off a strip that lifts the projecting slab (parallax), so it is approximate to about 0.2 m
the curved corner at 9-11 (090327) is drawn square

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2021-03-26 (40 px/m), scripts/research/strip-row-profile.ts and ruler crops of 19-23: storey pitch 2.88 m (sill bands at 4.75-4.85, 7.65-7.8, 10.45-10.6 m; head bands 6.45-6.6, 9.35-9.5, 12.2-12.45 m); windows 4.95-6.45, 7.9-9.35, 10.6-12.2 m (1.45-1.6 m tall, sill 0.24-0.30 and head 0.80 of the storey from floors at 4.15/7.03/9.91 m); three windows 1.29-1.31 m wide per 6.0 m (window share 0.65); sill band 0.15 m, head band 0.15-0.20 m; coping top 14.0 m, so a 1.21 m parapet over the storeys (22 courses); canopy fascia 3.45-3.8 m apparent, sign band to 4.5 m, first-storey sills 4.95 m (23 courses of wall from the canopy top at about 3.68 m). detect-house-types --module=6: type A of 10 modules (071876-141138), body NCC 0.63-0.92
